description.p: Management UI for llmgwd, the Kleinia system model gateway: aggregated upstream sources with per-alias model mapping, per-app keys with quota windows, priority + weight routing, and usage accounting.
llmgwd（Kleinia 系统级模型网关）的管理界面：多上游模型源与别名映射、 按应用发放的密钥与配额、优先级 + 权重的分层路由、用量记账。

Initial G0 slice: six pages (overview, sources, models, keys, routing, usage), mock backend with live simulated data, D-Bus management-plane client (system bus or peer-to-peer address), GNOME Shell search provider.
首个 G0 切片：六页（概览/模型源/模型/应用与密钥/ 路由/用量）、带模拟数据的 mock 后端、D-Bus 管理面客户端（system 总线或对等连接）、GNOME Shell 全局搜索 provider。
